description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: The upgrade to .NET 10.0 LTS was explicitly requested. .NET Framework 4.8 is Windows-only and receives no new features; moving to .NET 10 provides long-term support, modern APIs, performance and security improvements.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the ContosoUniversity project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0, including project file modernization, dependency updates, web framework migration, and API compatibility fixes.
tasks.taskSummary: Converted ContosoUniversity to SDK-style .NET 10 and ASP.NET Core MVC, migrated EF Core and application hosting, and added two NotificationService unit tests. Build succeeded with no warnings/errors and both tests passed; live LocalDB validation was not run.
